name: Tornadizos de Ávila (Spain)
description: Square red flag with a yellow cross throughout within a green border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Tornadizos de Ávila (a yellow Latin cross on red within a green bordure of bulls).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 14 December 1994 (Boletín Oficial del Estado no. 14 of 17 January 1995); the arms show a gold Latin cross on red within a green bordure with four silver bull sculptures.

features.role: Tornadizos de Ávila arms — Latin cross within a bordure of bulls
